variants.style: Preserve PHOTOREALISTIC fruit photography: lifelike skin pores, grape bloom, natural seeds, lifelike botanical leaves. No toy materials.
variants.prompt:
Create a corrected-layout production version of this exact transparent 12-fruit sprite atlas. Input image is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the same fruit artwork identities, colors and material style, but CHANGE SCALE AND POSITIONS SIGNIFICANTLY: every complete fruit must be MUCH SMALLER than in the reference, occupying ONLY THE CENTRAL 60 PERCENT of its cell. Output 1536x1152, exact 4 columns x 3 rows of 384x384 cells. Each complete subject INCLUDING ALL STEMS AND LEAVES must fit inside a 230x230 bounding square centered at its cell center, leaving AT LEAST 72 PIXELS of fully transparent space on EVERY side of EVERY cell. This large transparent spacing is the MAIN purpose. Fruit centers: row1 (192,192),(576,192),(960,192),(1344,192); row2 (192,576),(576,576),(960,576),(1344,576); row3 (192,960),(576,960),(960,960),(1344,960). No pixels of any fruit may be near the cell borders. Huge transparent gutters; do not enlarge subjects to fill the canvas.
Exact order: row1 compact purple grape bunch, red cherry pair with stems, red strawberry, orange mandarin. Row2 yellow lemon, round kiwi cut face with natural seeds, pink peach, red apple. Row3 golden pineapple with its ENTIRE compact green crown, netted cantaloupe, whole green striped watermelon, red watermelon slice. ALL fruit including crowns/stems comfortably fit in their centered 230x230 squares; shrink the whole pineapple as much as needed. All natural fruit patterns and textures preserved. The lemon has only its own leaf and NO pineapple fragments. The kiwi has natural seeds in a ring and white center. The watermelon slice has natural seeds.
NO eyes, NO pupils, NO mouths, NO faces, NO smiles, NO blush, NO eyebrows, NO limbs, NO anthropomorphism on ANY fruit. No character expression of any sort. These are pure material-and-fruit studies. No parts of adjacent fruit, no colored fringe, no particles, no cast shadows outside the isolated silhouettes. Real alpha transparency, no background, no checkerboard drawn, no ground, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no logos, no watermark. Preserve rich fine textures and soft upper-left lighting. The final atlas should look notably airy with much more blank transparent space than the reference.
Preserve PHOTOREALISTIC fruit photography: lifelike skin pores, grape bloom, natural seeds, lifelike botanical leaves. No toy materials.
